source: D-PBI-029 post-launch measurement architecture for the implemented Epic D homepage. No pixel, custom event, app, or consent change is authorized.
futureCustomEventApprovalRequirements: Duplication check against existing pixels and native ecommerce tracking

measures.metricQuestion: Do visitors who land on the homepage continue through the primary Machines action to useful machine shopping outcomes?
measures.metric: Homepage landing sessions, Machines destination sessions, product continuation, and online-store conversion outcomes; exact hero-click count only through a future approved event.
measures.source: Native Shopify sessions by landing page, destination collection/product reporting, and online-store conversion reporting; optional future module-click event.
measures.eventOwner: Analytics Owner, approval required before event implementation
measures.privacyConsentImplications: Native aggregate reporting adds no theme code. A placement-specific click event requires privacy and consent review.
measures.baselinePeriod: First 28 days after approved Epic D homepage launch
measures.reviewCadence: Monthly for the first three months, then quarterly.
measures.targetSuccessInterpretation: Baseline first, threshold pending Product/Analytics review.
measures.decisionInformed: Whether primary CTA wording, hierarchy, or Machines destination quality needs revision without duplicating native conversion events.
